title: Vela Bramblewick
kicker: a scout who would rather carry a warning than a blade
hook: a scout who would rather carry a warning than a blade

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A wiry Bramble scout peers from a thorn-woven hood, jaw clenched, blue charm bright against layered leaf armor and stolen road scraps.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Quick, anxious, and proud of being trusted with eyes instead of a weapon. Clicks a green stone against her teeth when she thinks. Wants the camp to keep listening to her more than she wants this fight to happen.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: Parley path Capture/mercy branch Evidence that the road conflict is bigger than banditry
